import numpy as np
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.core import Model
from astropy.modeling.separable import _separable, separability_matrix

def _cstack_fixed(left, right):
    """Fixed version of _cstack"""
    from astropy.modeling.separable import _compute_n_outputs
    
    noutp = _compute_n_outputs(left, right)

    if isinstance(left, Model):
        from astropy.modeling.separable import _coord_matrix
